# SACSCOC Reaffirmation Timeline

This timeline is based on **Track A** (undergraduate institutions). Institutions offering graduate degrees follow Track B with different dates.

::: {.callout-note}
## Important Timeline Note
This timeline is calibrated to a **June 2029 Board Action** date. Orientation occurs in December 2026, 30 months before board action.
:::

## Quick Reference: Key Dates

| Milestone | Date | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| Orientation Meeting | December 2026 | Required attendance for Leadership Team |
| Compliance Certification Due | March 2028 | Submission to SACSCOC |
| Off-Site Review | May 2028 | Peer evaluator review |
| QEP and Focused Report Due | July-October 2028 | 6 weeks before on-site |
| On-Site Visit | September–November 2028 | Campus visit by committee |
| Response Due | May 2029 | 5 months after visit |
| Board Action | June 2029 | SACSCOC Board decision |

---

## Detailed Timeline by Phase

### Phase 1: Preparation (June 2026 – June 2027)

::: {.timeline-item}
**Form Leadership Team** (June 2026)

- Assign Accreditation Liaison
- Include representatives from academic affairs, student services, finance, IE
- Limit to 5 members for Orientation Meeting attendance
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
**Review Standards and Handbook** (July 2026)

- Review 2024 Principles of Accreditation
- Review Handbook for Reaffirmation
- Conduct gap analysis
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
**Begin Compliance Certification Writing** (December 2026)

- Assign Standard owners
- Establish documentation system
- Begin drafting narratives
:::

### Phase 2: Orientation and Drafting (December 2026 – December 2027)

::: {.timeline-item}
**Attend SACSCOC Orientation Meeting** (December 2026)

- Required: Leadership Team attendance
- Submit Institutional Summary Form
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
**Identify QEP Topic** (February 2027)

- Topic must emerge from ongoing planning
- Form QEP Development Committee
- Begin broad-based involvement
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
**Complete Draft Compliance Certification** (September 2027)

- Prioritize Core Requirements
- Complete all Standard narratives
- Collect supporting evidence
:::

### Phase 3: Compliance Certification Submission (December 2027 – March 2028)

::: {.timeline-item}
**Final Review and Submission** (March 2028)

- CEO review and approval
- Update Institutional Summary Form
- Submit Compliance Certification
:::

### Phase 4: Off-Site Review (May 2028 – July 2028)

::: {.timeline-item}
**Off-Site Review Conducted** (May 2028)

- Peer evaluators review Compliance Certification
- Receive Off-Site Report
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
**Prepare Focused Report** (July 2028)

- Address Off-Site Committee findings
- Prepare additional evidence as needed
:::

### Phase 5: QEP and On-Site Preparation (July 2028 – October 2028)

::: {.timeline-item}
**Finalize and Submit QEP** (July-October 2028)

- Maximum 75 pages + 25 pages appendices
- Submit with Focused Report
- Due 6 weeks before on-site visit
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
**Prepare for On-Site Visit** (October–November 2028)

- Form hosting committee
- Reserve hotel and workroom
- Plan interview schedule
- Campus awareness campaign
:::

### Phase 6: On-Site Visit (September–November 2028)

::: {.timeline-item}
**On-Site Visit** (September–November 2028)

- 2.5-3 day campus visit
- Interviews with campus constituents
- QEP presentation
- Exit conference
:::

### Phase 7: Response and Board Action (May 2029 – June 2029)

::: {.timeline-item}
**Submit Response** (May 2029)

- Due 5 months after on-site visit
- Address any remaining concerns
:::

::: {.timeline-item .completed}
**SACSCOC Board Action** (June 2029)

- Receive official notification
- Communicate results
:::

---

## Core Requirements Priority

The following Core Requirements should be prioritized for early completion:

| Priority | Standard | Title |
|----------|----------|-------|
| 1 | 2.1 | Institutional Mission |
| 2 | 7.1 | Institutional Planning |
| 3 | 8.1 | Student Achievement |
| 4 | 6.1 | Full-time Faculty |
| 5 | 9.1-9.3 | Program Content, Length, General Education |
| 6 | 13.1-13.2 | Financial Resources and Documents |
